==Biography==
Shushei was a high-elo player who has also played as the top and mid laner for various professional teams, e.g. [[FnaticRC]].

== Trivia ==
* Known for his {{ci|Gragas}} and {{ci|Alistar}} play early in his Career, popularizing the use of those champions as AP Carries.
* Played over 2,000 ranked games during Season 1.
* Partly responsible for the Season 2 double-AP meta.
* Formerly a HoN player with high ranking.
* Used to play World of Warcraft as a Death Knight. In the Wrath of the Lich King days, he was rewarded with a legendary axe by his guild.
* Among the first players to use {{ci|Vi}} in competitive play as well as AP {{ci|Evelynn}}.
* Won the MVP award for the Season One World Championship while on Fnatic.
* Founded DragonBorns with longtime friend [[HosaN]] after their departure from [[EloHell]].
* After a win in the LCS Warsaw qualifiers he chest-bumped his teammate Hosan causing him to fall.
* Inducted to Fnatic's Hall of Fame.<ref>[http://www.fnatic.com/content/95620/shushei-joins-the-fnatic-hall-of-fame Shushei joins the Fnatic Hall of Fame]''fnatic.com''</ref>
